subject.title: docs: honor resolved Crabbox provider configuration

question: Should the resolved-provider wording be accepted as a canonical shared-skill change and then synchronized into this repository, rather than merged as a downstream-only snapshot edit?
rationale: The desired behavior is already aligned with the canonical skill, but selecting the source-of-truth update and the appropriate downstream synchronization boundary requires repository-owner intent.

options.title: Update canonical skill, then sync
options.body: Apply or confirm the provider-routing change in https://github.com/openclaw/agent-skills and submit a traceable downstream synchronization update here.

options.title: Keep a documented repository-specific fork
options.body: Explicitly approve a ClawSweeper-specific divergence only if its extra operational guidance is intentionally different from the shared Crabbox skill.

recommendation.title: Update canonical skill, then sync
recommendation.body: Apply or confirm the provider-routing change in https://github.com/openclaw/agent-skills and submit a traceable downstream synchronization update here.

likelyOwner.reason: As the repository-member proposer, this person is the available routing contact for clarifying whether the intended change includes the canonical source and sync path.
